item.question: How does the SmoothInfo method improve upon traditional fractal dimension calculation techniques?
item.answer: The SmoothInfo method incorporates a smoothing factor to address zero values that occur with rare classes having few samples. This makes it more tolerant of sparse data compared to other methods.
